payments_kind_matches_payee.name: payments_kind_matches_payee
payments_kind_matches_payee.value:
("payments"."kind" = 'materials' and "payments"."request_id" is not null
      and "payments"."payee_supplier_id" is not null and "payments"."payee_contact_id" is null)
    or ("payments"."kind" = 'labour' and "payments"."milestone_id" is not null
      and "payments"."payee_contact_id" is not null and "payments"."payee_supplier_id" is null)

payments_captured_has_capture_id.name: payments_captured_has_capture_id
payments_captured_has_capture_id.value: "payments"."status" <> 'captured' or ("payments"."paypal_capture_id" is not null and "payments"."captured_at" is not null)

verdicts_override_has_reason.name: verdicts_override_has_reason
verdicts_override_has_reason.value: "verdicts"."overridden_at" is null or ("verdicts"."override_reason" is not null and "verdicts"."overridden_by" is not null)
